title: What First Contact Frameworks Is
definition: First Contact Frameworks: protocols for humanity's first meeting with alien intelligence.
description:

title: The Signature Vision: First Contact Frameworks
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of First Contact Frameworks.

t: 2032 — First long-duration risk assessment testbed runs a sealed contac
title: 2032 — First long-duration risk assessment testbed runs a sealed contac
definition: 2032 milestone on the First Contact Frameworks roadmap.
description:
First long-duration risk assessment testbed runs a sealed contact hulls habitat for 1,000 days on Earth, proving the signal analysis recycling math.

What must be true first: the signal analysis results have to replicate outside the lab, contact logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and xenology teams operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed signal analysis demonstrations, contact logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting xenology teams uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: First Contact Frameworks
definition: Estimates First Contact Frameworks readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six First Contact Frameworks components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a contact hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: First Contact Frameworks Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates First Contact Frameworks operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a First Contact Frameworks installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 68569 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where signal analysis monitoring, contact logistics redundancy, or xenology teams maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: First Contact Frameworks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for First Contact Frameworks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for First Contact Frameworks — protocols for humanity's first meeting with alien intelligence.

Phase 1 — Prove (signal analysis): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (contact logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (xenology teams): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (risk assessment): contact hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and deep-space-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
